uncertainty: NCC boxes track a visible hair-covered cranium region; manual overlay inspection estimates center uncertainty±3sourcepx in main256×384cells and±5sourcepx in tail512×768cells. Templatepattern and minor headrotation are approximate; no false exactskeletal landmarks or desired target coordinates are represented as measurements.
review_scope: Actual source pixels and matched template overlays for all16selected poses inspected. No nativeprojection/chronologicaljoin/loop acceptance is claimed.
